[SWS_PHM_01335] Stopping of Alive Supervision for Self-Terminating Process
⌈
In case of Self-Terminating Process, Alive Supervision shall be
stopped on reporting of terminatingCheckpoint by the process or as soon as
Platform Health Management receives the information from Execution Manage- ment that the process will be notified to terminate (by issuing SIGTERM), whichever is
earlier.
⌋
